parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of results for each query.

Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to obtain the next page of backup policies.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr describe-policies-v2 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a --max-results 10 --policy-id po-0000000000000002l6 --region cn-hangzhou
